steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I knew it... you do love me!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Piss off! Who the **** is like you? Stay away from ${PlayerName}!
Phantom Hamel takes a heavy blow. Her form is shattered, but her voice remains. Her laughter is spinning among the monsters, and her now-indistinct figure seems to be doing a jolly dance.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: This is my amusement park, and everything in it follows my wishes.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Me... I hope you love me, your Hamel. Everyone loves Hamel.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She has a completely different aura from the person on the lake. Her manner, the nature of her power, her age, the way she dances... Are they really the same person?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Of course not. The one on the lake was not so full of f**king nonsense.

Chortling, the shapeless phantom starts dancing and twirling. Every inch of ground she covers sprouts dark tentacles, shaking and extending. They envelop the monsters, which are now howling even more desperately.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Are you scared? Are you in pain? The holes in your hearts, you can't fill them up, can you?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Come to me. I'll give you joy. Come and love me.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Be my dance dress, be the hem of my dress...
Before your eyes, the tentacles grow and expand amid the mass of monsters. They snatch up nearby Corruptors and suck out their black life force. They gather and swirl, condensing into a figure.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Is she absorbing the life force of the Corruptors?
Phantom Hamel reemerges before you, more powerful than before.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Hahaha... You won't feel sad anymore now...
Devouring Mania contamination for a power boost... You have seen this happen before.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: In the depths of the unclaimed crypt where the inheritance was awakened for the first time.
|In the black raincoat ritual where black flames were offered.

steps.content: It's more than likely that she has inside her something similar to the inheritance. That something devours Mania to boost its power.
Phantom Hamel is a Corpseborne Sinner too? The core of the Black Ring is an awakened Corpus?

Last time when this place was turned into an illusory realm, men clad in black raincoats sneaked into the carnival and created contamination to feed Phantom Hamel, or the owner of the Black Ring, so that she could be awakened and grow in strength.

You recall the mark on the backs of those raincoat men's hands, the same mark you saw on the man in the Black Ring incident in the square. They're from the same troupe, and they must have come here for the same purpose.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You're frowning. Something troubling you too?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I see it, your confusion, your loneliness, your pain... hehe, Let me give you comfort too.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You're keen on me too, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Yes, there's something I have to get cleared up.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Then come... Come to me.
The moment she raises her hand, the Corruptors by her side, as if possessed, turn to you and start charging at you, howling as they do so...
